reviews.t: This drill on its lowest setting is far too fast ...
reviews.x: This drill on its lowest setting is far too fast to use on nails.  I am a professional nail technician and can not use this drill on my clients nails.  Item was shipped quickly and in working order but is unusable due to safety standards.

UPDATE  BEWARE will stop working after a month!!! Just invest in a good drill. I will buy the kuppa again.  kuppa passport and it was stolen, definitely wasnt buying a $450 drill again. Found this dupe and wish I brought it before! It works great! Only thing is the forward/reverse button works backward. Im very happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: I would not  recommend nor repurchase
reviews.x: Honestly I had better expectations for this drill but you get what you pay for. It vibrated so heavily and did not perform anywhere near the arguments stated. Do yourself a favor by something better spend a little more money and get something that's a quality piece of equipment.

reviews.t: You will be happy with this Purchase
reviews.x: If your like me your skeptical of everything and put things back before deciding to finally get it..well this is one item you'll be glad you purchased , chargeable, low on the noise, no hard vibration, and comes with everything its pictured with

I picked this up to try doing my own acrylic nails at home. The drill was less than the cost of one fill so I figured even if all I did was try it one time it would be worth it. It came packaged very nicely with extra drill bits and a travel manicure set. I had to google what the different bits were best for. Yesterday I tried it for the first time and they came out surprisingly well. At least well enough for me to feel like I could leave them however they were for two weeks. I likely won't do t

reviews.t: Not even a year old and broken
reviews.x: I purchased this item in February of this year and was very pleased with it as was portable and helped me to ease up the space on my work desk and since I travel it was very convenient to carry along with me lightweight and small. It worked to my liking, but a few days ago I returned home to use my machine and I noticed the motor was almost skipping like it wasn't gripping the bit and was slowing while doing some work on a client was kind of embarrassing. I unwinded the top to see what might of

Purchase this drill about 4 months ago, and after about a month the motor started making a really loud noise. Even though the drill continued to work fairly well, at lower speeds the arbor bands specially would stutter and stop when trying to file. Then today the check in the handpiece jammed and now it won't lock.it worked well for a little while but I thought I would get a lot more than 4 months use out of it.
Very unhappy. Drill won’t stay charged and even after I charged it all night, when I cut it on it is very weak. The moment I place it to a mail it stops. Will be returning for a refund.
I loved the way it looks and the way it fit in my hands but the speed of the drill was too fast even at the lowest setting.
This product overheats in minutes and gets to the point where you can no longer hold it in your hand
Loved it but only lasted two uses.  It’s a POS

It’s really not the greatest. I think they should take “professional” out of the title. It’s not meant to be used professionally. I have to turn the speed all he way up in order to remove gel polish from acrylics. I needed a quick replacement while my Kupa e-file is being repaired. It gets the job done but my hands hurt a lot more because It just doesn't have the power that I’m used to. It takes a lot longer to do my job.

It stopped working after 1 month.  I can tell there's a short in the wire.  I wrote a message to the seller but so far haven't heard back:( I just wanted another hand piece since that is what stopped working. Other than that, while it worked,  it worked good. Not as powerful as the drills with foot pedals but it still did everything I needed it to.

reviews.t: powerful little drill well worth the price!
reviews.x: This drill was a great purchase! I was pleasantly at how powerful it is. It is fast ,not too loud ,and did not heat up. It was a little shaking but not bad at. I recently bought a more expensive drill but, I will use this as my backup. I would definitely recommend buying this drill it is so worth more than price charged.

Well I have had my drill for approximately 9 months now and don't use it to often and I went to use it and its not working. I noticed it was slow so I charged it for the 2nd time since I have had it  and its still slow. It skips and I had to turn it all the way up to use. I guess I got what I paid for.

I bought this drill June 5 and I use it for personal use and on my 4 the sent of nails and the speed control is malfunctioning I have to hold it for it to work. Mind you when I am done with this drill I clean it and put it back in it’s box after each use for storage.  Very disappointed in this item

I've had this drill for 2 years and it was performing great until the 4th time I tried to use it. The drill makes a whistling noise and does not rotate. I wouldn't recommend this for professional use nor at home use. I bought this for personal use and it was dying out by the 3rd use.

It's so much better having one that is attached to anything other than your hip. I feel like I have  more freedom to move and position myself however needed. Very low noise and the perfect size for my hand. The bits and easy to change. I love it.

But must definitely I have to said charge dont last long enough so if you are a nail tech really active nawww like I said for beginners the are in practice it will work but I got a week ago and sorry to said I am looking for another one already

I thought I was going to love it till I went to use it today or a friend's nails and it quit working on me. It seems as if it has a loose wire connection or something and wasn't very powerful enough to file my friends nails. So disappointed

I’ve had this drill for about 3 weeks and the bits pictured with this product is not the bits I got and I didn’t get the 100 sand bands .. I’m having to buy the bits I need.. if you have another option then go with that one not this one

reviews.t: After 5 months of use on one person the cord goes very disappointed
reviews.x: Not so good when the cord gives out on one person use in 5 months. Very disappointed I use this twice to three times a month just my own use and it no longer works. No idea if repair is possible so having to buy another one.

I liked the look and feel of this drill but I had to send it back because of the on/off switch did not click in the correct place. The switch was out of sync. I did not reorder for fear the next one might also be defective.
I really like this product.. it’s light and easy to used.. you can barely here the sound of the drill and it’s perfect size for my hand to hold. My co worker love it and got one herself ..
Ive had for a month no complants. I rarely use in full power. It works well to file down my dipped, gel, or acrylic nails. I also like that you can reverse directions.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the drill stops working or breaks after a short time, often within a month to under a year.
Some users find the drill too fast even on its lowest setting, making it unsuitable for nail work.
A number of reviewers praise the drill as powerful and good value for the price.
Some reviewers report overheating, heavy vibration, or weak performance and charging issues.
Some users say it lacks professional-level power and requires high speed to remove product.
